title: Teardown Charges on Teardown Estimates (Repair Estimates & Appointments Desk Reference)
content:
## Applies to

A Repair Estimates & Appointments teardown charge posts once on the estimate written date of a booking whose estimate type includes a teardown — the Blueprint Teardown Estimate and the Structural Blueprint Estimate, whose vehicles are disassembled to find hidden damage before the estimate is written.

## How it is invoked

The desk posts the charge with the agent-side tool `post_teardown_charge_9aa30e52`. The tool is unlocked first and then called by the agent with the amount already worked out; the tool itself checks no policy condition.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | Reference number of the estimate booking the teardown is charged on, as returned by the estimate booking lookup | Id |
| `amount_usd` | Teardown charge posted | USD with 2 decimal places, positive; a value with more decimals is rounded half-up to the cent when stored |

## Return

On success one teardown charge, dated today, stands on the booking's estimate-stage fees and the booking balance rises by the amount. The confirmation names the new charge reference number (an id beginning with "eev"), the booking reference number and the amount posted in USD with 2 decimals; seeing that reference number means the teardown charge now stands on the booking. It can then be paid or waived by quoting its charge reference number.
